title: The high shelf
starting_code:
# Find the book with `find_nearest` and keep it under a name.

# Make it glow with `reveal`.

# Walk right until you stand right under it.

# Cast fendra with `cast` and the book's name.

# Pick it up with `pick_up`.

# Give it to Eldra with `give`.
hints: Walk right until you stand right below the glowing book.
intro: Eldra's other lost book is up on the high shelf among all the others, and she cannot tell which one it is. Your program can! Find it, make it glow, stand under it, bring it down with *fendra*, pick it up, and give it to her.
outro: Both her books are back! Eldra is at peace at last.
